theme: An open Friday, likely in Maine
greeting: A quiet, open day, Dan — a single appointment this afternoon and an evening that leans toward tomorrow's show. The real wins today are a couple of bookings that have waited long enough.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 task (overdue since Sep 14) to hold a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week. The Pathfinder heads south this month, so this is the only six-seater for the girls' Maine trip — and holiday inventory there sells out early.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide and book the three-week December trip for all four girls by Oct 15 (p2, overdue Sep 30). Passports land early-to-mid November, so the clean default is a domestic shortlist you can book now without risk.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week window to drive Portland → St Pete is open right now. Set the dates and book the one hotel night; it replaces a flight rather than adding a trip.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Beach signing
needsAttention.detail: A second reminder from the signing service for 102 26th Ave, St Pete Beach — the document is still waiting on your signature.

schedule.title: Haircut
schedule.detail: The one fixed point in the day.

flagged.title: SVP Global Public Policy — interview step
flagged.detail: An interview-update email asks you to confirm work authorization for the SVP, Global Public Policy role (REQ64085). Worth a careful read, and a glance at the sender, before you respond.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley ACH processed
flagged.detail: A $15,000 ACH transfer request was processed this morning — a confirmation only, no action needed unless it looks unexpected.

flagged.title: Experian credit alert
flagged.detail: Experian flagged a new change on your credit file (a credit-balance increase). A quick sign-in confirms it's you.

flagged.title: ICGN Q3 policy update
flagged.detail: ICGN published its Q3 2026 policy-engagement summary — governance reading for a spare window.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — Italian word of the day, coffee, car sales, a LinkedIn invite, local roundups.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Autumn roots and winter squash are at their sweetest now, perfect for a slow roast.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: A clear, unhurried stretch — the strongest run of open hours all day sits here.
One pin mid-afternoon downtown; the hours on either side are unclaimed.
An easy wind-down, with tomorrow pointing toward Portland and the State Theatre.
